correctness.rationale: For N>=3 the literal Eq.(9) is eta_N(psi)=A(psi)=mean one-qubit entropy on the open set of genuine pure states and eta_N=0 on the complement, a finite union of closed proper rank-one flattening varieties with empty interior. A is continuous by finite-dimensional entropy continuity. The genuine set is open dense, so eta is continuous on genuine states and also at fully product states where A=0 and 0<=eta<=A. Every partially entangled product-across-cut state has A>0, eta=0, and dense genuine sequences with eta->A, proving precisely the claimed discontinuity and jump. For N=3 a Bell pair times pure qubit reaches 2/3 and all biseparable states have A<=2/3. For N>=4 a Bell pair times GHZ_{N-2} reaches the universal A<=1 bound. This is a complete analytical proof, no numerical inference.
